# Environment

How to make a checkout usable for the repository's toolchain extractors, as its CI does: `.github/projections/environment.json` or `.projections/environment.json`. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/environment/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/environment/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/environment/v0.json).

## Document

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | string |  |  |
| `format` | `"projections.environment"` | Yes |  |
| `version` | `0` | Yes |  |
| `prepare` | array of [`step`](#step) |  | Run in order in a workspace before a toolchain extractor runs there, and in the working tree only on demand (`projections prepare`). They are repository code, so they need `--trust`. At most 20 items. |
| `toolchain` | array of array of string |  | Commands whose output identifies the toolchain, such as `node --version`; part of the environment fingerprint that keys cached environmental extractions. At most 10 items. |
| `workspace` | object |  |  |
| `workspace.strategy` | `"fresh"` or `"worktree"` or `"clone"` or `"sparse"` or `"none"` | Yes | The team's workspace strategy for this repository; a developer's `--workspace` or user configuration overrides it. |
| `devcontainer` | string |  | A devcontainer configuration describing the same environment. Reported by `projections doctor`; not run. Pattern `^(?!/)(?!.*(^\|/)\.\.(/\|$))[^\\\u0000]+$`. At least 1 character. At most 1024 characters. |

No other properties are allowed.

## Definitions

### `step`

One command that makes a checkout usable, such as installing its dependencies.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Yes | Names the step in logs, records and failures. Pattern `^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,99}$`. |
| `run` | array of string | Yes | A program and its arguments, run directly, never through a shell. At least 1 item. At most 100 items. |
| `key` | array of string | Yes | Globs (`*` within a path segment, `**` across them) of the files whose content decides whether the step must run again, typically lockfiles and manifests. The step reruns only when their paths or contents change. At least 1 item. At most 50 items. |
| `directory` | string |  | The working directory, relative to the checkout. Default `.`. Pattern `^(?!/)(?!.*(^\|/)\.\.(/\|$))[^\\\u0000]+$`. At least 1 character. At most 1024 characters. |
| `environment` | array of string |  | Variables passed through from the invoking environment, besides the home, cache, temporary-directory and proxy variables every step receives. Steps may use the network. Items are unique. |
| `timeoutMs` | integer |  | How long the step may run. Default ten minutes, at most an hour. At least 1. At most 3600000. |

No other properties are allowed.
